gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta reads clean and open, its cut-back terminals leaving big gaps. Under Goldman's wide, commanding capitals, a long page of it would feel spacious and unhurried, with that dominant x-height carrying each line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Goldman spreads its bold, commanding letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses. Noto Sans Ugaritic is the pair's strongest card, with its tight x-height to cap height and chalk-arc mouths left unjoined.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-vai: Round forms like open parentheses, set wide with generous clearance: that is Goldman's whole personality. Noto Sans Vai keeps words as solid blocks, so shrinking the heading would waste its width, while the plain sans body stays happy at modest sizes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Goldman stretches its bold letters wide, with a tall lowercase that nearly matches its capitals and rounds like open parentheses. Noto Sans Vithkuqi does the quieter work, with open throats on a, c, e and s.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Goldman's round forms look like open parentheses, set wide with generous clearance and a commanding voice up front. And Noto Sans Wancho counters with a hulking lowercase, thick as chalk pressed hard, built for the steady text underneath.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi makes words read as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter. And Goldman's widely set, parenthesis-round capitals sit above it, giving the page a bold front door and a tidy, contemporary room behind.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-yi: Noto Sans Yi has a deep midsection in its lowercase, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. And Goldman, wide and commanding above it, gives that modern text a bold, generously spaced headline voice.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-sq: Wide, bold, a bit swaggering. Goldman's parenthesis-round forms lead, and Noto Sans Zanabazar Square follows with a soaring x-height and wide gaps, so paragraphs of it stay crisp and approachable even at tiny sizes.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads calm and unvarying, with broad gaps at the terminals and barely any step up to capitals. Readex Pro would carry a long page without tiring, letting Autour One's expressive, bold display letters do the shouting.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-roboto: Roboto brings generous mouths on its round letters and a clean, contemporary feel. But Funnel Display's spaghetti-like, constant strokes carry the expressive, commanding side, while the sans quietly handles the reading.
